items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: I remember the name. Ray Charles Cuttergold after he did.

ctx.x: company, but anyway, he had a record company there.

Yeah, I know who it is, but I can't call it. Yeah, so him and I got together, I said, name, how about Nick? No, the first thing was, Slim wrote a song in his hotel room. He wrote it on one of these laundry bags, remember the laundry bag, you'd be in brown paper. He wrote the whole song, he came in my room and sang the song to me. He said, what are you thinking about it? I said, it's all right. I said, you want to cut it? He said, yeah. I said, well, I'm going to talk to this guy who was at the club last night. He…
Well, that record just really went tough off.
